title: Probing AI — Touch Probe & Inspection Intelligence

units.title: 16 Probing AI domains with Claude Opus prompts
units.details: Added 16 PROBING-AI domains: probe_calibration (probe qualification), probe_datum_setting (WCS establishment), probe_part_setup (part alignment), probe_feature_measure (bore/boss/web), probe_surface_measure (surface probing), probe_tool_setting (TLS length/diameter), probe_tool_breakage (breakage detection), probe_compensation (auto work offset), probe_spc_integration (SPC data collection), probe_adaptive_machining (adaptive from probe), probe_cycle_selection (O9xxx selection), probe_renishaw (Renishaw-specific), probe_blum (Blum-specific), probe_macro_programming (probing macros), probe_error_handling (error recovery), probe_reporting (results output)

summary: Complete probing AI intelligence with 16 domains covering probe calibration, datum setting, part setup, feature/surface measurement, tool setting, breakage detection, work offset compensation, SPC integration, adaptive machining, cycle selection, Renishaw/Blum specifics, macro programming, error handling, and reporting. Deep expertise from 90+ Renishaw cycles and inspection posts.
